_comment: Human-editable and authoritative: the model never overrules this file.
French (fr-FR). Change here, not in prompts.
locked — tokens that must survive verbatim into French (content/SCHEMA.md 'Do not translate').
The §3.1 dial parameter names (duty, fidelity, latency, noise, control, contrary) and the
receipt symbol 'u' are NOT locked here although SCHEMA.md lists them: they are composed in
JS and never appear in map prose. If they ever enter the map as literals, add them back.
preferred — the terms of art, fixed once so the site never calls one thing by three names.
en:    the English term, matched as a whole word (plural allowed, hyphenated
compounds and other suffixes not: 'seat' does not fire on 're-seats')
use:   the French term the translation must use
match: the stem the compliance check looks for in the French (defaults to 'use');
keep stems short and unaccented-safe so gender and number both match
caseSensitive: require the capital. Rarely needed in French, which does not
capitalize common nouns the way German does.
The second block mirrors the terms the German/Spanish pilots caught the model guessing
wrong on short UI strings (witness/report, fidelity/loyalty, collapse/grip, preset).
They are pinned here up front so French does not have to rediscover the same failures.
